title: index status reports grammar unknown for author and content, which have no grammar to have
body: `intent index status` reports `grammar: author  unknown` and `grammar: content  unknown` beside `grammar: shell  no-grammar` and `elixir`, `rust`, `swift` `ready`. author and content are prose kinds with no grammar to have; `unknown` is the word for a state the reporter could not determine, and the row already has the word for a language without a grammar. Say `no-grammar` (or omit prose kinds from the grammar rows), so the report does not read as a lookup that failed.
